thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm prototyping a timeboxed automatic fallback that handbacks to primary after a cooldown window. Need engineering + ops + design take on the UI and audit surface. :wave:
kevin: Love the idea. question: how do we show the reason for fallback in the operator inbox? do we include discrete error triggers or a short narrative?
leah: discrete error codes + human-readable short reason is best. we should also show the samples that triggered it (maybe 3 examples).
tom: Agree. also think about quota/backpressure. If fallback is due to 'quota-overshoot' we should link the quota panel so operators can quickly adjust commits.
maria: good call. proposal: "trigger_reason" (enum) + "raw_log_snippet" (3 examples) + link to quota dialog.
andy: ops question — what about partial fallback? like degrade only for a subset of routes for a window? how's that surfaced?
leah: UI: show a small badge on route row -> "degraded (partial: 40%)". clicking opens the policy + a timeline with % of traffic affected.
kevin: backend note: policy is expressed as JSON, something like:
```
{
  "policy": "timebox-handback",
  "trigger": {"type":"latency_spike","threshold_ms":1200},
  "scope": {"routes":["/chat","/summarize"],"sample_pct":40},
  "handback_after_s":300
}
```
kevin: telemetry needs to capture trigger_event_id so the audit log can replay.
ops-bot: Alert: fallback applied to /chat at 2024-05-09T21:14:05Z (trigger_id=trg_8a9f).
maria: perfect, ops-bot linkable trigger_id is exactly what I want for traceability. design-bot: thinking about operator actions — propose two buttons: [Pause] (stop further fallbacks for Xm), [Escalate] (create incident + assign).
design-bot: also adding a small "preview" toggle that simulates how the output would look under fallback (so product can glance at quality delta).
andy: edge-case: what if fallback oscillates (flip-flop) because traffic is spiky? we should add hysteresis and a cooldown that is explicit in the UI.
kevin: we already plan a cool-down param, but agree we should show it and allow shorter override for SREs. maybe role-gated.
leah: audit requirements: every automatic fallback must write an immutable record with: trigger_id, policy_snapshot, sample_examples, metrics_snapshot, operator_overrides(if any).
tom: logging format suggestion: one-line JSON record per fallback with keys for quick grep + a pointer to the s3 blob for full snapshot.
maria: question for ops: do we want automatic sampling of examples (configurable) or always capture first N requests that match trigger?
andy: configurable, because some customers are privacy-sensitive. default: sample first 3 non-sensitive examples, redact PII.
kevin: implement redaction stage in collector. mark sample as redacted=true. good to call out in UI.
design-bot: UX note — show small shield icon when samples are redacted with hover text "examples redacted for privacy".
ops-bot: Note: quota-triggered fallbacks should include "affected_commit_id" so we can correlate billing.
maria: next steps: 1) kevin & andy scope telemetry + API contract; 2) leah & design-bot wireframe audit panel; 3) tom add policy JSON schema and durable-logging plan. I'll sync with legal on sampling defaults.
kevin: will mock the API today and share a minimal OpenAPI snippet.
leah: wireframes by EOD.
andy: will draft redaction rules and role-gates.
maria: thanks all — can we reconvene tomorrow 10am to review the preview toggle flow? :thumbsup:
